name: Portrait kiosk idle warning
describe: Unattended-kiosk idle warning: after session_idle_timeout_minutes without pointerdown/keydown (useIdleReset) a "Still there?" dialog covers the menu on a blurred scrim, with a full-width primary "I'm still here" button; without a reply it resets the session after 15 s.

Use on the menu screen when the guest walks away. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels (self-order has no locale file).
